metadata.description: Comprehensive Core/Content/Utility feature inventory for Minecraft implementation with sequential delivery tracking

core.name: Shared hydrology signature contract v20
core.description: Shared signature updated to v20 and consumed by server/client map-control signature builders.

core.name: Server-authoritative profile version 24
core.description: World generation and runtime map-control profile targets bumped to v24.

core.name: Unity world config parity v24
core.description: Unity world config defaults and StreamingAssets world config aligned to profile version 24.

core.name: World Generation System
core.description: Procedural terrain generation with heightmaps, biomes, caves, rivers, and lakes using improved algorithms.

core.name: Networking & Protocol System
core.description: Client-server communication using Google Protobuf with enhanced message handling.

core.name: Player Systems
core.description: Player movement, authentication, and basic interactions with server authority.

core.name: Block System
core.description: Block placement, removal, and basic block management with server validation.

core.name: Chunk Management System
core.description: Chunk loading, unloading, and rendering optimization with server-side authority.

core.name: Configuration System
core.description: Data-driven JSON configuration for server and client with validation.

core.name: World Map Control & Hydrology Sync
core.description: Server/client aligned world map control profile with hydrology-aware terrain masks.
improvements_needed: Hydrology-aware river/lake carving with seam relaxation
Expose seam-stabilized masks to Unity loaders
Document JSON knobs and profile generation flow

core.name: EnhancedMinecraft Protocol Validation
core.description: Google Protobuf pipeline validation to ensure generated packets and handlers stay aligned.
improvements_needed: Descriptor binding coverage for required and optional packets
Handler contract validation per message type
Fingerprint/hash guardrails to catch stale bindings
Surface-level self test during server startup

core.name: World Config & Map Control Parity
core.description: Keep Unity world config aligned with server hydrology/cave/lake knobs.
improvements_needed: Keep profile hashes in sync across server and client builds
Regenerate world-map-control profiles when config versions increment
Validate hydrology, lake, and cave knobs against streamed profile data

core.name: Terrain Mask Parity
core.description: Share hydrology-aware cave, river, and lake masks between server and client.
improvements_needed: Reuse hydrology/flow masks for both server chunk carving and client previews
Reload map-control profiles and pipelines when profile hashes drift
Feather cave/river/lake seams near chunk borders using shared masks

content.name: Catchment-braiding river bridge
content.description: River generation gains catchment-braiding bridge pass to reduce seam fragmentation.

content.name: Lake catchment spillway stitch
content.description: Lake generation adds spillway stitch pass for river-connected continuity.

content.name: Cave hydrology seam vault
content.description: Cave generation adds hydrology seam vault sealing for aquifer/riparian stability.

content.name: Items & Equipment System
content.description: Tools, weapons, armor, and miscellaneous items with data-driven definitions.

content.name: Crafting System
content.description: Hand crafting, workbench, furnace, and recipe management with data-driven recipes.

content.name: Mobs & Entities System
content.description: Animals, monsters, NPCs, and entity management with server authority.

content.name: Structures & Buildings
content.description: Generated structures, buildings, and architectural elements.

content.name: World Features System
content.description: Environmental systems, dimensions, and world mechanics.

content.name: Ores & Resources System
content.description: Mineral distribution, mining, and resource management with data-driven configuration.

utility.name: Server chunk inflight dedup cache
utility.description: WorldMapControlManager now deduplicates inflight chunk generation tasks and clears them on profile reload/signature drift.

utility.name: Client queue/building budget hardening
utility.description: Unity map preview controller tracks queued/building chunks to avoid duplicate builds and enforces queue budget deterministically.

utility.name: Proto probe profile diagnostics
utility.description: Dummy protocol client now warns on invalid world-map profile versions in addition to signature drift.

utility.name: Session-58 manifest bootstrap
utility.description: Server startup now prioritizes session-58 feature manifest loading for sequential implementation visibility.

utility.name: User Interface System
utility.description: HUD, menus, inventory management, and user interactions.

utility.name: Server Management System
utility.description: Server administration, moderation, and management tools.

utility.name: Development Tools
utility.description: Tools for content creation, debugging, and development.

utility.name: Data Management System
utility.description: Save system, data validation, and data integrity with SQLite integration.

utility.name: Performance & Optimization System
utility.description: System performance, memory management, and optimization.

performance_requirements.memory_optimization: Optimize memory usage and garbage collection

security_requirements.rate_limiting: Implement rate limiting and DDoS protection
security_requirements.permissions: Complete permission system with role-based access
